title: CASPER-IIoT: Frozen CloudSim Plus Online-Dispatch Publication Artifact
description:
This record archives the frozen CASPER-IIoT reproducibility package for a companion manuscript prepared for Future Generation Computer Systems. The artifact documents a publication-scale online-dispatch CloudSim Plus campaign with 30 seed replications, five scenarios, eight policy variants, and 1,200 scenario-policy-seed runs.

The release is metadata-only with respect to the scientific protocol: it does not retune parameters, alter workloads, change thresholds, change policies, or overwrite frozen E4.6 results. The hidden-network-loss scenario is preserved as a transparent robustness boundary rather than treated as an execution failure.
